samples.xml_description:
<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A 4-bit wide buffer capable of holding up to 4 entries, supporting push and pop operations based on RW signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input data to be pushed onto the buffer.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal (1 for read, 0 for write).</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal to activate buffer operations.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the buffer.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating whether the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating whether the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output data retrieved from the buffer.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="EMPTY_BUFFER">Stack pointer value indicating an empty buffer.</parameter>
        <parameter id="FULL_BUFFER">Stack pointer value indicating a full buffer.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="EMPTY" description="Check if the stack pointer equals the EMPTY_BUFFER state.">EMPTY = (SP == EMPTY_BUFFER);</assign>
        <assign id="FULL" description="Check if the stack pointer equals the FULL_BUFFER state.">FULL = (SP == FULL_BUFFER);</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic" sensitivity="posedge Clk">
        <if condition="EN">
            <if condition="Rst">
                <assign id="SP" description="Set stack pointer to EMPTY_BUFFER on reset.">SP <= EMPTY_BUFFER;</assign>
                <for loop_control_variable="i" start_value="0" end_value="3">
                    <assign id="stack_mem[i]" description="Initialize stack memory locations to 0 on reset.">stack_mem[i] <= 4'h0;</assign>
                </for>
            </else begin
                <if condition="!FULL && !RW">
                    <assign id="SP" description="Decrement stack pointer after pushing data.">SP <= SP - 1;</assign>
                    <assign id="stack_mem[SP]" description="Push data onto the stack.">stack_mem[SP] <= dataIn;</assign>
                </if>
                <if condition="!EMPTY && RW">
                    <assign id="SP" description="Increment stack pointer after popping data.">SP <= SP + 1;</assign>
                    <assign id="dataOut" description="Pop data from the stack.">dataOut <= stack_mem[SP];</assign>
                    <assign id="stack_mem[SP]" description="Clear the stack memory location after popping.">stack_mem[SP] <= 4'h0;</assign>
                </if>
            </end>
        </if>
    </logic_description>
</module>
